alerts.detail: De'Zhaun Stribling (SF WR) moved QUESTIONABLE -> DOUBTFUL — ankle. Stribling (ankle) is expected to miss at least one month after he was diagnosed Sunday with a deltoid sprain of his left ankle, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

Cooper Rush (ATL QB) moved QUESTIONABLE -> ACTIVE. Rush reported improvement after experiencing back spasms Saturday and remains on track to start the Falcons' season opener Sunday versus the Steelers, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
